calendar.name: Official LIFELINE calendar - Project Statement section 7.4, page 7
calendar.note: Daily changes start from the base case. Wave indices are zero-based positions in sorted wave labels, wrapping modulo the number of waves. Only days 6 and 7 retain the union of every wave. Stock resets each day; no extra expiry rule is prescribed.
